page.overview:
Who is Baxcon?

Baxcon is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared in the Riku Royal Army Headquarters beneath the Flower Field.

Baxcon is a large, muscular dwarf with lightly-tanned skin. He has a very thick, muscular neck, small eyes, small ears, and predominant cheek bones. He also has large teeth, thick lips, long, dark hair that sticks upward, bushy eyebrows, a matching bushy beard, and a dark colored tail. He wears dark-colored pants with a studded belt and a similar sash across his chest.

Little is known about Baxcon's personality, since he is fairly quiet. He is quite brave, having sacrificed himself to allow his comrades to continue Operation SOP.

Baxcon seems fairly strong, being able to topple Lao G with the assistance of Nubon and Daikon. He was not, however, strong enough to greatly damage the pirate.
